Rooms.Name: Crypt Entrance
Rooms.Description:
You enter into a musty smelling anteroom from the main entrance to the 
crypt.  Strangely enough you don't see any indication of coffins or corpses
of any type. Along one wall are ledges that look like they might at one time
have held a body, but they have long since been removed. In one corner you 
do see a very old pile of bones.  Above the bones on the wall you can 
barely make out a message scrawled there.  Maybe you should 'read message'.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Beware of the Trogs, they were to much for me and this is as far as I could
make it.  They busted my legs, but I killed them.  I was stupid to go down
there before I was 5th level.  I hope this message saves someone from the
horrible pain that I am fe..........  The message ends in a dark brown stain.

Rooms.Name: Dim Cavern
Rooms.Description:
You come down into a tremendous cave-in to the south.  It isn't clear how 
long ago the earth shifted and the roof of the tunnel collapsed, but it is
clear that no further travel to the south is possible this way.  You spot
a few bones and pieces of broken equipment here, and the shadows your light
cast off the large stones among those that block your passage seem to dance
and flicker evilly.  You have a strong urge to flee.

Exits.Description: There seems to be an irregular shape here, hmm maybe a secret passage.

Rooms.Name: Ambush!
Rooms.Description:
Well, you've found an explanation for the broken bones. A party of
well armed troglodytes have marked your travel down the road and have been
waiting patiently for you to arrive. They seem to have come from a small hole
in the west wall you hadn't noticed before, as it was partially hidden by one
of the large rocks that has fallen from the ceiling.

Rooms.Name: Many Tunnels
Rooms.Description:
This is a twisty underground tunnel with many exits and entrances. The
ground is more or less even, but the passage walls are so similar in kind that
it is impossible to differentiate one passage from another by them. There are
exits leading to the east and west. The tunnel floor has been worn smooth by
the passage of many feet.

Rooms.Name: Spider Cave
Rooms.Description:
This might have been a troglodyte cave at one time, but it is currently
inhabited by a couple of really hungry looking cave spiders. It's hard to read
their expressions, but they seem to be looking at you in a manner that implies
you are going to be lunch. You notice a lot of broken bones on the floor here,
and there are some partially drained troglodyte corpses up in the webbing that
is suspended from the ceiling.

Rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a small, smelly cave. There are bits of junk scattered
about the dirty floor, personal things of the cave's occupant - a large and
particularly evil looking troglodyte. The conditions he is living in are
pitiful, and you turn your nose in disgust at the remains of a rotted tunnel
rat that he discards as you enter. Looks like he's found a more appetizing
meal.

Rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
Rooms.Description:
This cave is really nothing more than a slightly larger tunnel than most,
but it serves as an outpost for several troglodyte watchmen, who don't seem to
think much of your visit. They don't like your light very much. In fact, from
their behavior you might even think they don't like you!

Rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
Rooms.Description:
You seem to have stumbled upon an outpost of the troglodytes that live in
this region. In fact, from the sounds and glimpses to movement you see to the
west, you might have stumbled upon a troglodyte settlement. There are several
large troglodytes here will be glad to show you around. Well, they might be
willing to at least carry bits of you around, after they're done taking you
apart.

Rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
Rooms.Description:
This cave is apparently home to a bunch of real slobs. Not surprisingly,
it is adolescent troglodytes that live here. There are pieces of broken bone
and little bits of metal and glass scattered about the floor, as well as the
"valuables" of the cave's residents. You can hear the sounds of metal hitting
metal coming from the south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
There are bits of broken armor, the skull of a tunnel rat, pieces of string
and other such items of little worth.

Rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
Rooms.Description:
This cave is clearly a practice area for young troglodytes to hone their
skills of maiming and killing. The cave wall is an impressive dark brown -
dried blood from the less successful of those tutored here. Apparently they
play-fight awfully rough. The broken weapons and scraps of armor lying about
testify to this fact as well. The only exit is to the north.

Rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
Rooms.Description:
Mmm, you can smell some delicious tunnel rat stewing here, a cave that is
quite apparently the cooking area for the troglodytes living around here.
There are a few pots and pans here, though they are barely recognizable as
such. The small fire under the pot from which that yummy rat smell is being
emitted is barely enough to see by, but you can detect some troglodyte matrons
slaving over the cookery. They seem to think you'd make a nice addition to the
meal they're preparing. There is an exit to the south, and you hear what might
be the clatter of weapons coming from the east.

Rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
Rooms.Description:
It's yet another troglodyte strong point. From the density of these things,
you'd have to think the troglodyte people were constantly under attack. Who
could be invading their homeland? You realize it's probably adventurers like
you they guard themselves against. The cave is large and has two exits, one
each to the north and south. There is a funny, slightly unpleasant smell
coming from the north.

Rooms.Name: Many Tunnels
Rooms.Description:
This is a twisty underground tunnel with many exits and entrances. The
ground is more or less even, but the passage walls are so similar in kind that
it is impossible to differentiate one passage from another by them. There are
exits leading to the north, east and west. The tunnel floor has been worn
smooth by the passage of many feet.

Exits.Description:
There is a sign carved in the south wall. It reads:

       _____
      /     \
      | O O |
       \uuu/
       /nnn\
       \___/
    O____ ____O
     ____X____
    O         O

Rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
Rooms.Description:
This is the entrance of a large cave, that extends to the west and then
branches out further to the north. It is likely that you have found the
beginning of the main troglodyte community, as they are quite numerous here.
>From their reaction to you, you'd think they are of the opinion you are
invading their privacy or something. There are three exits - east back into the
tunnels, west deeper into the caves, and north into the unknown.

Rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
Rooms.Description:
You are in the south westernmost arc of a large cave shaped approximately
like a donut, with an extremely large column in the center of the cavern. The
diameter of the column, you estimate, is probably about two-thirds of that of
the cave itself. It makes for a very strange tunnel-like effect, but it looks
natural though you have no idea what force of nature might have caused it.
This is where the troglodytes hone their weapons and repair their armor. From
the looks of things, it appears as if it's a skill they've been working on for
some time; though their tools are limited their armor and weapons are in
excellent shape. Maybe the Repair Guy had some troglodyte blood, who knows?
As you enter the cave, the many troglodytes working in here eye your armor and
weapons appreciatively.

Rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
Rooms.Description:
This is the northeastern cave of a linked set of four caves, which could
also be characterized as a single cave with an awfully big column in the
center.  From what you can tell, the cave is shaped more or less like a big
donut. In this section of the cave, female troglodytes are working on
extracting those vital vitamins and minerals from recent kills, by crushing
the bones into a powder which gets mixed into an occasional meal. There are
a couple of young trogs running around here, annoying those working. All this
activity ceases when you enter, and they turn to the task of defending their
home. In addition to the exits along the cave to the west and south.

Rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
Rooms.Description:
This cave appears to be the nursery. Normally, the troglodyte young and
their guardians are here, playing games and learning new skills. The cave is
entirely unlit normally, and the presence of your light source appears to be
the brightest thing some of the little trogs have ever seen. Again, it strikes
you that you might be trespassing. There is a larger cave off to the south,
and there are also cavern to the north and west.

Rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
Rooms.Description:
This is a smaller cave than any of the others in this area. It appears to
be a hidden twin strong point to the one directly east of here, from which the
cave you are currently in is not clearly visible. Ordinarily, this position
would be occupied by troglodytes watching over the other strong point to the
east, preparing to reinforce them in case of any trouble.

Rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
Rooms.Description:
You are in the female troglodytes sleeping quarters - as nice a place as
you think you've ever seen, for a cave. It looks like the place has been
cleaned with a toothbrush... even the dirt on the cave floor looks clean. The
rocks are shiny and sparkle at you, hinting at worth in their glittering
cleanliness, even though you know they are without value. There are ordinarily
several female troglodytes here, in serious discussion.

Rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
Rooms.Description:
This large cave is the sleeping quarters of most of the male troglodytes,
a fact that is evinced more than anything by the bad smell and the large mess.
How so many creatures who don't believe in bathing could live together in one
room is beyond comprehension. Perhaps troglodytes have no sense of smell. This
place is such a mess, you imagine they must have bad vision, too, to tolerate
it. The cave is normally occupied by a few troglodyte soldiers, catching a nap
between guard duties.

Rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
Rooms.Description:
The cave you are in resembles a tunnel more than anything, and might be
labeled as such if it weren't so wide. In fact, though, you are in a cavern
with an extremely large column of natural stone in the middle, which blocks
the view of the other side of the cavern from your current position. This part
of the cave is a practice area for adult troglodytes, as there are scraps of
metal and wood scattered about the floor in silent testimony to past rites of
supremacy that determine the clan chief. There are exits to the north and east.

Rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
Rooms.Description:
You are now in the northwest arc of a large, donut shaped cave. This is
likely the place where the soldiers work out their strategy and formations, as
you can see a bunch of rocks set on a stone "table" (really just a large, flat
rock), ostensibly the staging grounds for mock battles and strategic plots by
troglodytes here for many a year, given how smooth the top has now been worn.
There are also several crude drawings on the wall, though what they are of, it
is hard to say for sure. The cave continues to the south and east, and there
are also passageways leading to the west and north.

Rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
Rooms.Description:
This is the chief's "private" cave. Apparently being the leader of these
people has some privileges, at least. The caves furnishings are only slightly
more ornate here than anywhere else, though, so apparently the job isn't
exactly loaded with perks. The chief is here, talking with his top fighters
about prospects of battle. They turn to you, knowing now the battle they had
been anticipating is already upon them. There is an exit to the south.

Rooms.Name: Caves of the Troglodytes
Rooms.Description:
This cave is apparently the place where the troglodyte chief receives his
guests. There is a large case filled with trophies from past victories of the
troglodyte clan. Among the trophies, you spot a battered Golden Shield, the
skull of a cave fisher, with some dents and a big hole just over the right
eye, a small crystal sphere, and dull gray helmet with a plume that was once
probably white. The mementos here range from the unexpected to the astounding.
You are impressed by the ability of such a seemingly limited people to have
defeated such a large and varied set of opponents. You can exit east

Rooms.Name: The Entrance to The Catacombs
Rooms.Description:
This place feels chilly and faintly damp. It is the burial grounds for many
prominent and other less prominent citizens of Midgaard. Two huge stone doors
stand widely open. The place is dimly lit by torches on the walls. A small sign
is visible on one of the doors. To the south there is a raspberry bush.#N

Exits.Description: Through the doors, the upper Catacombs begin.
Stairs lead up to the temple.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The sign reads:  Beware of undead creatures of the dark

These two huge doors don't seem to have been touched in years.  They must
be so heavy that none have been able to close them.

Behind the raspberry bush you spot a hole. Hmm, seems to be a entrance
to a cave here. There is a strange deep carving on the stone wall... six
runes. You translate... 

"M..E..no..A..L?..yes..I..errr..@$#%^...N..and..A..again"
Yes! It says "Malina!"... What the heck is a Malina?#N

Rooms.Name: Upper Catacombs
Rooms.Description:
This wide hallway is only dimly lit by torches. Along the north wall,
there are many alcoves, probably graves of some higher ranking Midgaard
citizens. The hallway continues to the east and the west.#N

Exits.Description: The hallway continues to the east.
Through huge stone doors you see the entrance.

Rooms.Name: The long hallway
Rooms.Description:
Along both sides of this long and cold hallway, there are many more resting
places for the dead. They have all been tightly sealed though, should anyone by
any chance want to disturb the rest of the dead. Far to the east end of this
corridor there is a small staircase leading down into darkness. To the west it
seems to be lighter - probably the entrance.

Exits.Description: The hallway continues to the west, getting brighter.
Small stairs lead down into darkness.

Rooms.Name: Cellars of Catacombs
Rooms.Description:
Cold and stagnant air fills this place. It smells stale and of death. These
tunnels must be deep below the city. The only thing that disturbs the silence
is water dripping down occasionally from the earth ceiling, and muffled screams
for away. This tunnel continues to the north and west. A small staircase lead
back up.

Exits.Description: Stairs lead up to the Catacombs.

Rooms.Name: The Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
Bones and debris cover the ground in this tunnel. It leads east-west. There
a iron grate to the north.

Exits.Description: Through the grate you see mounds of unmoving shapes.

Rooms.Name: The Tunnel of Death
Rooms.Description:
The sense of death is everywhere. In the air, in the ground and in the
silence, that is only disturbed by occasionally dripping water. The tunnel
leads east and north. A ladder is secured on the west wall, leading up.

Exits.Description: A ladder in the west wall leads up. There seems to be light up there.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The ladder seems strong and well made.  Also very well secured to the wall.

Rooms.Name: Western End
Rooms.Description:
The western end of this corridor is lit with torches. It continues to the
east. A ladder leads down into darkness.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The ladder seem strong enough to hold several persons at a time.

Rooms.Name: The Burial Room
Rooms.Description:
This huge room smells of death, both ancient and very recent. Skeletons and
semi-decomposed corpses litter the ground. You can hear the squeaks of rats or
other vermin. There don't seem to be any other exit besides a grate to the
south.

Rooms.Name: Smelly Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
The smell in this tunnel makes even you want to lose your breakfast. Some
corpses lie in small ponds of water. You can see small things moving on the
corpses. Just hope there aren't any big things too.

Rooms.Name: Turning Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
Besides the usual smell and dripping water, nothing specials is found in
this room. You can continue south or west.

Rooms.Name: Large Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
This large tunnel connects to all the four bearings. To the east and west,
the tunnel continues. To north and south there seems to be rooms or caves of
some sort.

Exits.Description: To the north a there's a room.
You can see a large cave.

Rooms.Name: Turning
Rooms.Description:
East and south the tunnel goes on. Rats squeaking and running makes the only
noise. Bones litter and debris cover.

Rooms.Name: Dark Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
Somehow the earthen walls here seems to suck away the light, shading
everything, making everything gloomy and cold. This north-south passage also
feels more humid, like death was breathing not far away.

Rooms.Name: Large Cave
Rooms.Description:
This large cave is filled with skeletons, corpses, rats and other vermin
that goes with death.

Rooms.Name: The Room of the Dead
Rooms.Description:
This cold room differs from the rest of the Catacombs. It has stone walls.
But that is the only difference. It is still cold and smelly, and though no
water drips from the ceiling, the air is still humid. In the north, stairs
descend into deeper darkness.

Exits.Description: The stairs of stone are cracked and lead only to darkness.

Rooms.Name: The Lower Catacombs
Rooms.Description:
This place feels even colder, as if the earth itself tries to absorb the
little warmth that is left, avoiding to freeze to death. Though still there,
the dripping of water has lessened and the squeaking of vermin too. Besides the
stairs that lead back up to warmth and life, the way leads to east and west.

Rooms.Name: Catacomb Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
Nothing distinguish this tunnel from the rest you have seen. The cold is
still there. And the dread of what is to come. East or west.

Rooms.Name: Turning
Rooms.Description:
The tunnel turn here. This place feel vaguely familiar. Nowhere to go
besides west or north.

Rooms.Name: Catacomb Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
The similarity of this foul place makes it hard to keep bearings. Nothing
besides old roots and bones makes it hard to find a mark. North or south.

Rooms.Name: Catacomb T-junction
Rooms.Description:
From here you can go in three directions. You are sure you have been here
before.

Rooms.Name: Catacomb Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
The tunnels seem to continue forever. Will it ever end? This tunnel looks
just like the others. Perhaps little narrower. Or maybe the pressure of the
ground has oppressed your head.

Rooms.Name: Turning
Rooms.Description:
The tunnel turn here. This place feel vaguely familiar. Nowhere to go
besides west or south.

Rooms.Name: Catacomb Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
Huge piles of bones litter this tunnel. Crawling of them are bugs and small
creatures of the earth. Creatures that don't need light. Creatures that avoid
light.

Rooms.Name: Catacomb T-junction
Rooms.Description:
From here you can go in three directions. You are sure you have been here
before.

Rooms.Name: Catacomb Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
Nothing distinguish this tunnel from the rest you have seen. The cold is
still there. And the dread of what is to come. East or west.

Rooms.Name: Another Turning
Rooms.Description:
This endless turnings of this tunnel almost makes you dizzy. When will this
end? Will you get out alive or will you join the rest of the dead?

Rooms.Name: North-south Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
This tunnel feels little warmer in the air. Many small fungus is growing on
the walls. Where can they find anything to grow on you wonder. Maybe from the
corpses of ignorant adventurers.

Rooms.Name: Catacomb T-junction
Rooms.Description:
From here you can go in three directions. You are sure you have been here
before.

Rooms.Name: Low Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
Roots from long dead trees hangs down from the earth ceiling above. You try
your best to avoid the bugs on them.

Rooms.Name: Turn in the Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
The air here feels ancient and heavy, as if you are the first to disturb it
in centuries. That is not true however since you discover tracks of something
that has dragged itself past here.

Rooms.Name: Catacomb Tunnel
Rooms.Description:
This tunnel is wide. Cobwebs and roots covers the ceiling and bones and
other debris cover the ground. You can go east or west.

Rooms.Name: Catacomb Room
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a large cavelike room. Stone floor covers the ground but
the ceiling is still earthen and with roots dangling down. The remains of a
seemly huge stone table lies here, broken and tattered.

Rooms.Name: Storage Room
Rooms.Description:
This room seems to have been used as a storage room of some sort. Piles of
old broken wood lies to the north wall. Some unfinished coffins lie to the
east. A small sign lie on the floor, dusty of age.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It says: Property of Harold & Son

Rooms.Name: Altar Chamber
Rooms.Description:
This room is dominated by a large altar. Old blood cover the altar, as if
some obscene rite of offering has taken place here. You also discover blood not
so old - only a few days at the most.

Rooms.Name: Storage Room
Rooms.Description:
This seems to be storage room for tools. Shovels and picks lies everywhere.
All are broken and rusty and of little use now.

Rooms.Name: Smelly Room
Rooms.Description:
This room smells awful. A large ovenlike structure lies in the middle of
room. The smell comes from burnt flesh. Broken pots and crockery lines the east
wall, all empty and dusty.

Rooms.Name: Empty Room
Rooms.Description: This room looks empty. Besides dust and dirt there is nothing.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to the Crypt
Rooms.Description:
A huge stone door is to the north is inscribed with the word 'CRYPTS'.
Besides that the rooms seems too clean. No dust or bones or debris cover the
stone floor.

Rooms.Name: Torture Room
Rooms.Description:
This room was made to torture people in. The sight of the room is enough to
make you shudder. Shackles line the walls. Instruments of torture litter the
floor, rusty of time.

Mobs.Name: rat
Mobs.LongDescription: A giant rat is here chewing on some bones.
Mobs.Description:
This looks like an ordinary rat, but it is far much larger.  It's red eyes
don't show nothing but hunger.

Mobs.Name: skeleton
Mobs.LongDescription: A skeleton scrambles slowly around here.
Mobs.Description:
The skeleton still have parts of old dirty clothes on it, but the flesh
seems to have long ago vanished.

Mobs.Name: necro necromancer
Mobs.LongDescription: A necromancer is here looking for spare parts.
Mobs.Description: Black robes cover him or her.  You can't be sure which in the dark.

Mobs.Name: zombie
Mobs.LongDescription: A zombie smells your living flesh and shambles towards you.
Mobs.Description: Rotten flesh and old molded clothes covers this foul evil creature.

Mobs.Name: ghoul
Mobs.LongDescription: A ghoul that hates living things is here waiting.
Mobs.Description: Rotten flesh and old molded clothes covers this foul evil creature.

Mobs.Name: troglodyte trog
Mobs.LongDescription: A large troglodyte pounces on you from behind a stone!
Mobs.Description:
An ugly troglodtye with large yellow teeth stands here, preparing to make you
into a meal for the whole family. He eyes your weapons and armor greedily.

Mobs.Name: lieutenant trog troglodyte
Mobs.LongDescription: A troglodyte lieutenant stands here, ording others about.
Mobs.Description: He is in complete control here.

Mobs.Name: cave spider
Mobs.LongDescription: The cave spider hangs nimbly from the webby roof.
Mobs.Description:
The spider's hard exoskeleton is covered with an oily substance that keeps its
sticky webs from clinging to it. It is large and quite dangerous looking.

Mobs.Name: troglodyte trog evil
Mobs.LongDescription: The troglodyte attacks you with a yell!
Mobs.Description:
He is dirty, and covered in grime and dried blood, some of which is apparently
his own. He doesn't look particularly well fed, but would like to take this
opportunity to improve that situation.

Mobs.Name: troglodyte guard trog
Mobs.LongDescription: The troglodyte guardsman defends his post from all invaders.
Mobs.Description:
They guard their post diligently, fighting off all who would attack their
homeland and pose a threat to the survival of their people. Each is armored
and carries a sharp weapon.

Mobs.Name: troglodyte teen trog
Mobs.LongDescription: The young troglodyte rests here between training sessions.
Mobs.Description:
He looks at you with alarm. He isn't sure whether he should stay and fight, or
run. He scrambles for his weapons, just in case...

Mobs.Name: troglodyte adolescent student trog
Mobs.LongDescription: The young troglodyte is bashing his fellows with abandon.
Mobs.Description: He looks at his battlemaster, who urges him to slay you.

Mobs.Name: troglodyte trog battlemaster
Mobs.LongDescription: The battlemaster screams at his pupils to attack, then assaults you himself.
Mobs.Description:
He is extremely large, and is covered with battlescars. His armor is nice, and
is finely polished, as is his sword, which is sharp and wicked looking.

Mobs.Name: troglodyte trog clansman
Mobs.LongDescription: The troglodyte clansman cries for aid as he defends his homeland.
Mobs.Description:
He looks like an ordinary troglodyte, about six feet tall, weighing slightly
less than two hundred pounds. He is well armored, and carries a sharp weapon.

Mobs.Name: troglodyte trog clansman
Mobs.LongDescription: The troglodyte clansman is here, foraging for food.
Mobs.Description:
He looks like an ordinary troglodyte, about six feet tall, weighing slightly
less than two hundred pounds. He is well armored, and carries a sharp weapon.

Mobs.Name: tunnel rat
Mobs.LongDescription: There is a tunnel rat here, running for its life.
Mobs.Description:
It is trying desperately to avoid becoming a troglodyte meal, like others of
its kind. It edges away as you approach.

Mobs.Name: troglodyte cook trog
Mobs.LongDescription: A troglodyte cook is here, slaving over an pot of tunnel rat stew.
Mobs.Description:
She looks at you as if you would make an excellent addition to the stew. Given
the large knife she brandishes at you, you think she just might do it, too.

Mobs.Name: troglodyte shaman trog
Mobs.LongDescription: A troglodyte shaman is here, mumbling incantations.
Mobs.Description:
She curses you, lifting aloft the small humanoid skull around her neck. The
incantations spewing from her mouth send shivers down your spine.

Mobs.Name: troglodyte chief trog
Mobs.LongDescription: The great chief of the troglodytes is here, regarding you dispassionately.
Mobs.Description:
He is the largest troglodyte you've ever seen. He is covered with battle scars.
He looks at you with resignation, and slowly pulls out his great sword for
battle.

Mobs.Name: troglodyte clanswoman trog
Mobs.LongDescription: The troglodyte clanswoman is here, crushing bone to paste.
Mobs.Description: She doesn't appear to think much or your company.

Mobs.Name: troglodyte matron trog
Mobs.LongDescription: The troglodyte matron is here, watching over the young.
Mobs.Description: She would kill you just for *thinking* about touching one of the little ones.

Mobs.Name: troglodyte young trog
Mobs.LongDescription: The young troglodyte is annoying the adults here.
Mobs.Description: It ceases all such activity when you enter, and attacks you dutifully.

Mobs.Name: troglodyte infant trog
Mobs.LongDescription: The infant troglodyte is here, waddling around and acting cute.
Mobs.Description: It's too young to understand the concept of killing.

Mobs.Name: lieutenant trog troglodyte
Mobs.LongDescription: The chief's lieutenants snarl and attack.
Mobs.Description: They hope to impress their leader with your swift destruction.

Objects.Name: sword long
Objects.Description: A long sword has been left here.

Objects.Name: club wooden
Objects.Description: A simple looking wooden club is here.

Objects.Name: warhammer hammer
Objects.Description: A medium sized warhammer is here.

Objects.Name: flail large
Objects.Description: A large flail is here.

Objects.Name: breast plate
Objects.Description: A breast plate is lying on the ground.

Objects.Name: chain mail shirt
Objects.Description: A chain mail shirt is lying on the ground.

Objects.Name: shield
Objects.Description: A small wooden shield is lying on the ground.

Objects.Name: jacket studded
Objects.Description: A studded leather jacket is lying on the ground.

Objects.Name: jacket scale mail
Objects.Description: A scale mail jacket is lying on the ground.

Objects.Name: helmet bronze
Objects.Description: A bronze helmet is lying on the ground.

Objects.Name: cap leather
Objects.Description: A leather cap is lying on the ground.

Objects.Name: leggings bronze
Objects.Description: A pair of bronze leggings is lying on the ground.

Objects.Name: pants leather
Objects.Description: A pair of leather pants is lying on the ground.

Objects.Name: sleeves bronze
Objects.Description: A pair of bronze sleeves is lying on the ground.

Objects.Name: sleeves leather
Objects.Description: A pair of leather sleeves is lying on the ground.

Objects.Name: sticky spider web
Objects.Description: There are sticky spider webs all over the roof,  with drained corpses inside.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The corpses look like those of troglodtyes, tunnel rats, and adventurers like
yourselves. You might be able to pull a couple of them out.

Objects.Name: troglodyte corpse
Objects.Description: There is a corpse of a troglodyte here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It has been completely drain of blood, and still has it's equipment.

Objects.Name: elf corpse
Objects.ShortDescription: The corpse of an elven adventurer
Objects.Description: An elven adventurer's corpse, covered with bite marks, is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It has been slightly drained of blood. Apparently the cave spiders didn't like
the taste of elven blood very much. It is fully equipped.

Objects.Name: black metal plate breast
Objects.Description: A black metal breast plate is lying on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This breast plate is made of a hard black metal of unknown origins. It has an
insignia emblazoned on the front you do not recognize - it is a white unicorn
rearing over an eclipsed sun.

Objects.Name: black gauntlets metal
Objects.ShortDescription: a pair of black metal gauntlets
Objects.Description: A pair of black metal gauntlets is lying in a small heap here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
There is have a small relief of a white unicorn over an eclipsed sun on the
back of each glove. They are light and extremely strong.

Objects.Name: black helm metal
Objects.Description: A black metal helm has been discarded here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Across the crest of the helmet there is a relief of a white unicorn rearing
over an eclipsed sun. The helmet is made of an unknown metal, possibly some
kind of adamantite compound, and is both light and extremely strong.

Objects.Name: black leg plates metal
Objects.ShortDescription: a pair of black metal leg plates
Objects.Description: A pair of black metal leg plates wait here for a new owner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Each of them has an engraving in the center. It is of a white unicorn rearing
over a solar eclipse. The plates are made of a strong, unknown black metal.

Objects.Name: black metal arm plates
Objects.ShortDescription: a pair of black metal arm plates
Objects.Description: a pair of black metal arm plates is lying here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Each of them has an engraving in the center. It is of a white unicorn rearing
over a solar eclipse. The plates are made of a strong, unknown black metal.

Objects.Name: black metal boots
Objects.ShortDescription: a pair of black metal boots
Objects.Description: A pair of black metal boots lie on the ground here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The boots are made from a strange black metal. They have a white unicorn
rearing over an eclisped sun emblazoned on the side, and look very sturdy.

Objects.Name: pot black iron
Objects.Description: A pot big enough to feed an army is here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It is hot, and covered with scratches. It must be two inches thick!

Objects.Name: brown liquid
Objects.Description: Some murky brown liquid
